body:
After working with the Configure widget, in order to have it integrated in the angular-instantsearch library I'll add my +1 to this issue. Also, @bobylito I think we should use the `renderFn` if any provided to the widget. I can see a widget with a `debug:` option where it prints on the page the configure search parameters applied like this: ```html 
{
	hitsPerPage: 3,
	page: 1
}
``` Also I think we should handle `refine` function if you want to update the `searchParameters` applied by Configure on the fly.
